Military

Battalions recruit from their colony's population (down to a 2,000 floor). Use the rebase button at the end of a row to move a stationed unit to another colony; travel time is the cheapest route cost divided by the unit's speed.

Diplomacy

How each alien species currently regards you (−100 hostile … +100 friendly) and your current standing. Attacking either way starts a war; sue for peace or propose pacts to change your standing.
SpeciesOpinionStatus

Trades

Active trade deals. Each grants access to a resource or happiness bonus in exchange for a yearly wealth payment, for a set number of years. A deal ends if either party attacks the other, or if their colonies lose their transport connection.
PartnerDirectionResourcePayment/yrYears left

Trade Offer

Propose Trade

Offer to buy access to a strategic resource, or a yearly amount of a basic resource, from an alien whose colonies are transport-connected to yours. They may accept, decline, or counter with their own price.

Propose Sell

Offer to sell an alien access to a strategic resource you control, or a yearly amount of a basic resource you can spare. Strategic resources the selected alien likely needs are highlighted. They may accept, decline, or counter.
